addr: Shetty Towers, 548, Chinmaya Mission Hospital Rd, Binnamangala, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: Very nice place, loads of collection. I was trying to get a specific colour legging which none of the stores in Indiranagar had, finally found it in blush. The store person is also very polite and nice. Bit expensive :)
The shop is worth a visit. Some of the collections are very selective. But now, Unable to contact to even know if the shop still exist.
I like this place.They keep latest collection and price is also reasonable.I bought 4-5 dresses from this shop and loved them a lot.Quality is super and dress is unique.
